svg.title: LSM Tree write path diagram
svg.desc: A flowchart showing how a write flows through an LSM storage engine: client write, WAL append, MemTable insert, flush trigger check, SSTable flush, and compaction.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does a client write request look like in an LSM engine?')
sendPrompt('Why does LSM write to WAL before MemTable?')
sendPrompt('How does the MemTable store data in memory?')
sendPrompt('What happens when MemTable is frozen during flush?')
sendPrompt('How is an SSTable written to disk from MemTable?')
sendPrompt('When does compaction trigger after an SSTable is written?')
g.text: Merge L0 → L1 → L2… if needed
